adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` explicitly builds a multi-host list (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking it only connects the first calendar (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), so the additional team-member destination calendars are not stored on the booking. Later, the cited handlers (`confirm`, `editLocation`, `requestReschedule`, `deleteCredential`) reconstruct `evt.destinationCalendar` only from `booking.destinationCalendar`/`user.destinationCalendar` wrapped into a one-element array, meaning any downstream logic that relies on `evt.destinationCalendar` being the full COLLECTIVE list cannot operate on all hosts’ calendars. This is a correctness gap exposed by the refactor to arrays.
